602561.name: Chabad of Fairfield
602561.note: Chabad.org (Lori Samlin Miller) on CrownHeights.info, 28 Dec 2015 ('Fairfield Chabad Center Spreads Its Wings'): Rabbi Shlame and Miriam Landa 'arrived in the area in 2007 and got to work right away, holding Jewish programming and services'; 'going on nine years now'. Its chabad.org listing went up 27 Nov 2007.

1556584.name: Chabad @ Wesleyan University
1556584.note: Lubavitch.com, 7 June 2017 ('At Wesleyan University, Jewish Life Sees Progress'): 'since the couple had opened Chabad at Wesleyan in 2011, they had had an increasing impact on Jewish students at Wesleyan University' (Rabbi Levi and Chanie Schectman, 'from their modest home'); in Dec 2016 they bought a building on campus. Its chabad.org listing went up 27 June 2011.
